job_title: Software Engineer, New Grad, Developer & End User Experience Platform

company_info.size: Approximately 9,073 employees worldwide as of March 2026
company_info.industry_info: Financial infrastructure and payment processing technology. Stripe is a platform that enables millions of companies to accept payments, grow revenue, and scale their business. The company operates in the FinTech/Payment Processing sector and holds 22.3% of the payment processing software market share.
company_info.recent_news: In April 2026, Stripe announced 288 launches including expansion of economic infrastructure for AI, new partnership with Google for AI Mode integration, launch of wallets for agents powered by Link, and major expansion to Stripe Treasury including instant free money transfers. In February 2026, Stripe achieved its highest-ever valuation of $159 billion through a tender offer. Stripe's Revenue and Finance Automation Suite is on track to hit $1 billion annual run rate in 2026, up from $500 million in early 2025.
company_info.company_culture: Based on Glassdoor reviews (3.7/5 stars from 1,351+ reviews), Stripe has a good working environment with 63% of employees recommending it to friends. However, work-life balance ratings are 3.2/5, indicating some concerns about work intensity. Employees rate the business outlook positively at 74%. The company emphasizes end-to-end ownership, early prototyping, community contribution, and open-source software. Stripe upholds a commitment to craft and beauty in its products. The company values collaborative, cross-functional work and mentorship for new grads.
company_info.any_related_information: Stripe is one of the most valuable private companies in the world. The company is actively hiring with 2,061 active job postings in 2026 (65.3% increase from 2025). Engineering comprises 44% of the workforce (3,977 employees). The Developer & End-user Experience Platform (DEeP) team is described as a force multiplier for the company and offers unparalleled career acceleration for new grads. New grad roles specifically target candidates starting before October 1, 2026, with a maximum of 18 months professional experience. The company operates with 50% in-office expectations at most locations (with some exceptions like Mexico City, Bengaluru, and Dublin at 100% in-office).
